=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh: `_mark_superseded` at lines 312 and 339, and its use in the required-set filter at lines 352-360 (`.conclusion != "cancelled" or (._superseded | not)`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A cancelled required check is dropped whenever any later check-run with the same name exists on the head, whichever workflow produced it.
  WHY: The final-merge gate and review-blocked judge call `_pr_checks_completed` without `PR_CHECKS_CI_RUN_IDS`, so an unrelated successful run can allow a merge without a successful required check.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: ready-to-merge loop at line 23310, `if _pr_checks_completed "${RTM_PR}" "${_rtm_head_sha}"` (two-argument legacy `*` mode) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: In `*` mode every check-run counts, so a cancelled advisory check-run that is newest of its name blocks the sub-issue PR merge.
  WHY: The reviewer says this is by design, is not a new defect, and clears when the job is re-run or a new head is pushed.

=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh: lines 263-268 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A successful "lint" check-run from an unrelated workflow will incorrectly mark a cancelled or failed "lint" check-run from the required CI workflow as "superseded".
  WHY: This can cause the gate to ignore the failure and permit the merge when it should block.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh: lines 324-340 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The legacy `_pr_checks_completed` filter does not distinguish between different workflows that share a job name.
  WHY: A newer successful same-name run from an unrelated workflow can cause the filter to ignore an older failed or cancelled required CI run, potentially allowing merges on branches without branch protection.
- Requirement: The gate must treat a cancelled required check-run as a settled failure unless a newer run of the same name exists, to ensure that orchestrator wave merges do not proceed if a required check-run was cancelled.
  Expected change site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh
  Evidence of absence: The logic in `_mark_superseded` (lines 263-268 and 324-340) groups check-runs strictly by `name` without workflow identity, allowing unrelated workflow runs to satisfy the merge gate requirements for the required CI workflow. The requirement for the check to be part of the same workflow is not implemented.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

  PROBLEM: The `_mark_superseded` jq function groups check-runs by `.name` only and marks every older run of the same name as `_superseded`, so a cancelled required check-run from workflow A can be superseded by a newer successful check-run with the same name from unrelated workflow B.

The reviewer notes that aligning the main gate would require extracting workflow identity from `details_url`, which is fragile.
